title: Official blog knowledge stage 9
summary: This iteration adds an internal relationship suggestion step for OpenAI and Anthropic official blog knowledge. Reviewed or intake-style candidates can now be compared against existing curated records by topics and admission criteria before final authoring, producing advisory related-blog suggestions without mutating knowledge records, fetching live pages, translating content, or writing public docs output.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "official blog relationship suggestions|official blog suggest-relations" tests/official-blog-knowledge.test.js tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: Official blog graph links should be suggested before authoring, not silently auto-written into curated records.
lessons.evidence: Stage 9 produces `official_blog_relationship_suggestions` as an internal advisory artifact and does not mutate `knowledge/official-blogs/**`.
lessons.recommended_action: Review suggested related blog ids during authoring and copy only accepted links into Stage 8 reviewed authoring fields.

lessons.lesson: Company identity alone is too weak for knowledge graph edges.
lessons.evidence: Stage 9 scores only records with shared topics, shared matched criteria, or existing reverse links; same-company context is only a bonus on top of substantive overlap.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep relation scoring tied to durable product, model, engineering, eval, safety, or agent workflow overlap.

lessons.lesson: Relationship diagnostics remain internal candidate metadata.
lessons.evidence: Stage 9 CLI `official-blog:suggest-relations` rejects public `docs/data`, `docs/official-blogs`, and public HTML output paths.
lessons.recommended_action: Expose only accepted curated relations through public knowledge records and keep scoring details out of public artifacts.

suggestions.issue: Reviewed official blog candidates had no deterministic way to discover related existing records before authoring `related_blog_ids`.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 9 adds `createOfficialBlogRelationshipSuggestions`, CLI command `official-blog:suggest-relations`, deterministic scoring by shared topics and matched criteria, duplicate reporting, invalid entry isolation, clean `--output` behavior, and public-output path rejection.
suggestions.suggestion: Use internal relationship suggestions as the reviewer handoff before final official blog authoring.
suggestions.expected_benefit: New OpenAI and Anthropic blog records can be linked into a reusable knowledge graph while preserving manual review and public-data minimization boundaries.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through deterministic relationship suggestion and CLI tests.
validation_evidence: official blog relationship suggestions rank shared topics and criteria without mutating records
official blog relationship suggestions report duplicates and suppress company-only matches
official blog suggest-relations CLI writes clean internal suggestions
official blog suggest-relations CLI refuses public output paths

followups.action: Let daily generation consume a compact official blog knowledge context capped by relationship suggestions and topic overlap.
Add optional live fetching only after it writes the Stage 7 preview feed artifact and remains separated from reviewed authoring and relation suggestions.
